points.description: Correctly computes the gemstone-assisted throw as 3 × 400 = 1200 feet and subtracts the dragon's 1000-foot reach to conclude Polly can stand 200 feet outside the reach of the flames, with every step mathematically valid.

rubric.notes: Full marks require a fully valid solution and the correct final answer of 200 feet. A single invalid step or an incorrect final answer earns no marks.
